nodes.name: Solid-state reaction for Sr2RuO4
nodes.procedure: Stoichiometric amounts of SrCO3 and RuO2 were weighed and mixed using a high-energy ball mill (Planetary Mono Mill, Pulverisette 6, Fritsch) in ethanol media under 400 rpm for 1 h. The homogeneously dispersed mixture was then dried and calcined at 1200 °C in air for 20 h to form the Sr2RuO4 powders.

The j0 value of Sr2RuO4 is 0.898 mA cm−2 , ... the Sr2RuO4 electrocatalyst delivers an extremely high TOF value of 0.90 s−1 at overpotential (η) of 0.1 V , ... at η = 0.1 V : , the Sr2RuO4 delivers an SA of 7.93 mA cm−2 BET

nodes.characterization_summary: All diffraction peaks of Sr₂RuO₄ match JCPDS No. 81-1978 with space group I4/mmm, confirming phase purity and K₂NiF₄-type RP structure.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 1a–c shows the X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns of R u O _ { 2 } , S r R u O _ { 3 } , and S r _ { 2 } R u O _ { 4 } powders... All diffraction peaks of the three oxide samples match well with those of the corresponding standard patterns (JCPDS No. 71-2273, 89-5713, and 81-1978, respectively), indicating their phase purity without observable impurities.

nodes.characterization_summary: SAED pattern along [010] zone axis shows tetragonally arranged diffraction spots confirming layered RP crystal structure of Sr₂RuO₄.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The layered RP crystal structure of S r _ { 2 } R u O _ { 4 } is further confirmed by the selected-area electron-diffraction (SAED) pattern along the [010] zone axes...

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows lattice fringe with spacing of 0.64 nm corresponding to (002) plane of Sr₂RuO₄.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In addition, a lattice fringe with lattice spacing of 0.64 n m was observed in the HRTEM image (Fig. 1f), corresponding to the (002) plane of S r _ { 2 } R u O _ { 4 } oxide.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ru-L₂,₃ XAS spectra of as-synthesized Sr₂RuO₄ identical to reference confirms stoichiometry and only Ru⁴⁺ oxidation state.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Supplementary Fig. 2 shows the R u – L _ { 2 , 3 } XAS spectra of the as-synthesized S r _ { 2 } R u O _ { 4 } sample and the reference samples... The R u – L _ { 2 , 3 } spectra of the as-synthesized S r _ { 2 } R u O _ { 4 } sample is completely the same as the reference S r _ { 2 } R u O _ { 4 } (including spectra shape and peak position), suggesting the character of stoichiometry and only R u ^ { 4 + } in the as-synthesized S r _ { 2 } R u O _ { 4 } sample.

nodes.characterization_summary: Micrometer-sized particles observed confirming bulk nature of Sr₂RuO₄ synthesized by solid-state reaction.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The morphologies of R u O _ { 2 } , S r R u O _ { 3 } , and S r _ { 2 } R u O _ { 4 } powders were examined by scanning electron microscopy (SEM)... Micrometer-sized particles were observed, suggesting the bulk nature of the as-synthesized S r R u O _ { 3 } and S r _ { 2 } R u O _ { 4 } oxides by solid-state reaction method.

nodes.characterization_summary: Sr₂RuO₄ has specific surface area of ~1.4 m² g⁻¹; RuO₂ has larger surface area.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Although the specific surface area of bulk S r _ { 2 } R u O _ { 4 } is relatively low ( ∼ 1.4 m ² g ⁻ ¹ )... R u O _ { 2 } appears to have smaller particle size than S r R u O _ { 3 } and S r _ { 2 } R u O _ { 4 } , and accordingly have larger surface areas as calculated from the Brunauer−Emmett−Teller (BET) measurements.

nodes.characterization_summary: O 1s XPS shows much larger number of -OH groups on Sr₂RuO₄ surface; Sr 3d confirms hydroxide surface species.
nodes.evidence_snippet: XPS spectra of O 1s species... demonstrate much larger number of − O H on the surface for S r _ { 2 } R u O _ { 4 } . Abundant − O H on the surface was further confirmed by considering the Sr 3d spectra of S r _ { 2 } R u O _ { 4 } ...

nodes.characterization_summary: Double-layer capacitance (Cdl) from CV shows ECSA of ADT-Sr₂RuO₄ nearly doubles compared to pristine Sr₂RuO₄.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The real oxide surface area and ECSA are estimated from the BET measurements... and double-layer capacitance ( C _ { d l } ) measurements... Figure 4b displays the current density differences as a function of scan rate of S r _ { 2 } R u O _ { 4 } and ADT- S r _ { 2 } R u O _ { 4 } , and the result displays that the ECSA of ADT- S r _ { 2 } R u O _ { 4 } is nearly two times larger than that of pristine S r _ { 2 } R u O _ { 4 } .

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM of ADT-Sr₂RuO₄ shows nanoparticles with radius 10-15 nm; lattice fringe of 0.23 nm corresponds to (001) plane of hexagonal Ru.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Supplementary Fig. 26 shows TEM images of the surface regions of ADT- S r _ { 2 } R u O _ { 4 } . It is clearly seen that some nanoparticles with a radius of 1 0 − 1 5 n m are dispersed... The lattice fringe with lattice space of 0.23 n m corresponds to the (001) plane of hexagonal Ru...

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM together with EDX confirms formation of metallic Ru nanoparticles and oxide on ADT-Sr₂RuO₄ surface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-angle annular dark-field scanning transmission electron microscopy (HAADF-STEM) image (Fig. 4e) together with the energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX) elemental mapping and point spectra (Fig. 4f) further collectively confirm the formation of metallic Ru nanoparticles and oxide on the surface of ADT- S r _ { 2 } R u O _ { 4 } .
